about: OpenLigaDB: a free community sports-results database for the Bundesliga and many other leagues. This CLI wraps its public JSON API at api.openligadb.de to list leagues, teams, matchdays, fixtures/results, standings, top scorers and change timestamps.

commands.summary: List all available leagues across all sports and seasons, with shortcut and season ids for the other commands
List leagues for one season from the website's league overview (name, created info, results/schedule links that contain the league shortcut)
List all sports available in OpenLigaDB
List the teams of a league in a season, with the teamId values used by match commands

params.name: league
params.description: League shortcut, e.g. bl1, bl2, bl3

commands.summary: List the matchdays (groups) of a league season, with groupOrderID used as the matchday number
Get the current matchday (group) of a league
List all matches (fixtures and results) of one matchday in a league season
List a league season's matches for teams whose name contains the given text

params.name: team
params.description: Part of a team name, e.g. Bayern. Must not be purely numeric, because a number is read as a matchday.

commands.summary: Get full details of one match by matchID: teams, results, goals, location and viewers
List all recorded matches between two teams, identified by teamId

params.name: team1
params.description: First teamId (from list-teams), e.g. 40 = FC Bayern

commands.summary: List a team's matches in a time window around today, given as weeks in the past and weeks in the future

params.name: weeksPast
params.description: Number of weeks back from today

params.name: weeksFuture
params.description: Number of weeks ahead of today

commands.summary: Get the next upcoming match of a league
Get the most recently played match of a league
Get the league table (standings) for a league season
Get the goal scorers ranking for a league season
Get the timestamp of the last data change for one matchday; a cheap poll before refetching match data
